atomic_reconstructor.precise_api_gap: The observed operation replaces a world ItemEntity stack with an output ItemEntity stack after the laser action. Horizon can queue a confirmed pickup into a machine slot, but does not expose the observed entity stack/components and an atomic consume-and-spawn/transform transaction for an arbitrary vanilla ItemEntity. Putting the result in a buffer would change the observed output location.
